title: Drop-Off Credit for Error Returns by Return Method - Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders
content:
For Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders, an error-return refund carries a drop-off credit set by the return method on the authorization being settled (the latest on the order in status received, by received date).

| Return method on the authorization | Drop-off credit |
|---|---|
| In store | $1.00 |
| Prepaid mail label | $0.50 |
| Freight pickup | Nothing |

The credit is a fixed amount for the settlement, whatever the number of units.

**Examples (hypothetical).**

- A dog bed returned at a store for a wrong item: drop-off credit $1.00.
- A pet fountain sent back with a prepaid mail label as defective: drop-off credit $0.50.
- A large crate collected by freight pickup as damaged: no drop-off credit.
